002.title: Препоръчани източници

entries.html: Stanford Encyclopedia of Philosophy, “Informal Logic.” A scholarly overview of informal argument evaluation, acceptability, relevance and sufficiency. https://plato.stanford.edu/entries/logic-informal/
Internet Encyclopedia of Philosophy, “Fallacies.” A comprehensive reference emphasizing that labels must be justified by identifying the actual reasoning error. https://iep.utm.edu/fallacy/

Stephen Toulmin, The Uses of Argument (1958; later editions). Influential treatment of claims, grounds, warrants, backing, qualifiers and rebuttals.
Anthony Weston, A Rulebook for Arguments (various editions). A compact, accessible introduction to constructing and scrutinizing arguments.

David Hume, A Treatise of Human Nature, Book III, Part I, Section I. Classic discussion relevant to the transition from descriptive to normative claims; read alongside modern commentary rather than as a complete contemporary treatment.

notes: В центъра на града и слънчевите сценарии са изградени учебни примери, а не открития за конкретен град или проект. Източниците по-горе подкрепят основните концепции на главата и осигуряват по-нататъшно проучване; това е синтез, а не научна литература преглед.
